name: Mellum2.1 12B-A2.5B Thinking

lineage.how_derived: same architecture as Mellum2 Thinking; almost all new work is post-training, mainly reinforcement learning (RL went from a short final stage to the main part of training)

purpose: Thinking model for complex agentic tasks (working in a repository, running commands, calling tools) and for hard non-agentic coding, math and reasoning problems (card note).

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Card tag and overview say Apache 2.0; the repo has no LICENSE file, so the text was not read.

architecture.attention: GQA 32 Q / 4 KV heads, sliding window 1,024 on 3 of every 4 layers
architecture.drafter: MTP head (JetBrains/Mellum2.1-12B-A2.5B-Thinking-MTP; MTP GGUFs in the official GGUF repo)
architecture.why_this_design: Architecture unchanged from Mellum2; the card gives the numbers (hidden 2304, intermediate 7168, MoE intermediate 896) but no reasons for them.

variants.notes: Q6_K 10.88, Q8_0 12.93, BF16 24.31 GB; MTP variants Q4_K_M 8.33 GB; 324k downloads
community quants, 9k downloads; sizes not checked

pc-12gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (9.6 GB)

pc-16gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (13.6 GB)

pc-24gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (21.6 GB)

pc-32gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (29.6 GB)

mac-16-24gb.notes: 8.1 GB file against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 8.1 GB file against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 8.1 GB file against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

engine_support.notes: Official GGUF repo for llama.cpp, Ollama and LM Studio; MTP for vLLM. Tona has no module for the mellum architecture.

benchmarks.name: SWE-bench Verified
benchmarks.variant: BF16, thinking mode (Mellum2 Thinking 2.0, Gemma 4 E4B 23.0, Qwen3.5 9B 50.0 in the same table)

strengths: 2.5B active parameters: fast decode, official GGUF at 8 GB
trained with millions of sandboxed runs in real repositories with a shell and file-edit tools, rewarded when tests pass (card)
weaknesses: below Qwen3.5-9B on SWE-bench Verified (47.0 vs 50.0), Terminal-Bench 2.1 (17.4 vs 21.7), SWE-bench Pro and GPQA in the vendor's own table
all numbers self-reported by JetBrains; no independent benchmark found
soft.behavior: thinking model; card sample uses max_tokens 81,920, temperature 0.6, top_p 0.95, top_k 20
soft.maturity: JetBrains, second generation of Mellum2 within about two months

tona_fit.reason: Light, Apache-tagged and fast (2.5B active), but the vendor's own table puts it below Qwen3.5-9B and far below the 27B-class coders on agentic benchmarks (SWE-bench Verified 47.0). A candidate for 12 GB cards as a quick agent only if independent numbers confirm it.
blockers: no Tona module for the mellum architecture

open_questions: user reports (none found by web search on 2026-11-19)

sources.note: web search result; no independent benchmark found
